notes: Natural distal-finger features only; no fiducial detector or paper corners.
Extrinsics initialized from AX=XB relative finger motions, without either previous calibration.
Depth bias is a separate nuisance diagnostic; all production calibration files remain unchanged.
Second analysis uses rigid proximal servo housings to avoid soft fingertip material and distal self-occlusion.

Rigid proximal housing is obscured by curled distal links in deep-PIP phases; exclude these phases from both fit and validation before estimating camera parameters. Static templates verify feature identity independently of cumulative optical flow.
